ENGLISH: For Such a Time
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 为现今的机会

ENGLISH: Queen Esther
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 以斯帖王后

ENGLISH: A decree of destruction. A queen who has not been summoned. One line in the law that could cost her everything.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这卷书一次也没有提到神，却处处都是祂安排的时间。

ENGLISH: c. 480 BC, in Susa, the winter capital of Persia — the largest empire in the world at the time. The queen, Esther, is Jewish, and almost nobody in the palace knows it.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 约公元前 480 年，波斯帝国的冬都书珊城。以斯帖是王后，也是犹太人——宫里几乎没有人知道这件事。

ENGLISH: Haman, the king’s favourite, was publicly refused a bow by Mordecai — a Jew, and Esther’s older cousin, who raised her. So Haman has drawn up a decree: on one day, every Jew in the empire may be killed. The king has signed it.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 王的宠臣哈曼，因为犹太人末底改不肯向他下拜，怀恨在心。末底改是以斯帖的堂兄，也是把她养大的人。哈曼拟了一道诏书：某一天，全国各省的犹太人都可以任人宰杀。王已经盖了印。

ENGLISH: Esther is the only person close enough to the king to intervene, and he has not called for her in thirty days. Walking into the throne room uninvited is a death sentence unless he holds out his golden sceptre.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 能接近王的只有以斯帖，可王已经三十天没有召见她。没有召见就闯进宝座殿，是死罪——除非王向她伸出金杖。

ENGLISH: Approaching the Persian king unsummoned carried the death penalty unless he extended the golden sceptre. Esther had not been called for thirty days. The book of Esther is unusual — God is never named in it — yet His providence is everywhere in the timing.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 没有召见就进见波斯王，除非王伸出金杖，否则是死罪。以斯帖已经三十天没有被召见。以斯帖记很特别——整卷书没有出现神的名字，祂的看顾却藏在每一个时机里。

ENGLISH: Providence often looks like an ordinary person in the right place, willing.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 神的安排，常常就是一个普通人，站在对的位置上，而且愿意。

ENGLISH: Esther’s bravery was not loud. She fasted, waited, chose her moment, and spoke with gentleness — a reminder that boldness and self-control are not opposites.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 以斯帖的勇敢一点都不张扬。她禁食、等候、挑时机、说话温和——胆识和温柔，从来不是对立的。

ENGLISH: Where might God have placed you “for such a time as this”?
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 神可能把你放在什么位置上，正好是「为现今的机会」？

ENGLISH: In my family, where I am the only one who prays
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 在家里，我是唯一祷告的那个人

ENGLISH: Esther’s first calling was in a palace nobody would call holy. Your address may be your assignment. Esther 4:14
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 以斯帖第一次被呼召，是在一座没人觉得圣洁的宫殿里。你现在站的地方，也许就是神给你的位置。以斯帖记 4:14

ENGLISH: At work or school, where I can quietly do the right thing
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 在工作里、学校里，我可以安静地把对的事做下去

ENGLISH: Mordecai’s small refusal to bow came long before the decree. Faithfulness in small things prepares you for large ones. Esther 3:2–5
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 末底改那次「不跪」，远在法令之前就发生了。小事上忠心，是在为大事预备你。以斯帖记 3:2–5

ENGLISH: I am not sure yet — but I want to be available
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 我还不确定——但我愿意被祂使用

ENGLISH: “Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?” is a question, not a command. Sit with it. Esther 4:14
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「焉知你得了王后的位分，不是为现今的机会吗？」这是一个问句，不是命令。慢慢想。以斯帖记 4:14

ENGLISH: The scroll opens on blue pillars, gold, and polished stone. Susa — the winter capital of the Persian empire.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 书卷在蓝色的柱子、黄金和磨光的石头之间展开。书珊城——波斯帝国的冬都。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Haman, the king’s highest official, has been furious that a Jew named Mordecai will not bow to him. So he has engineered something far worse than a personal feud.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 王的宠臣哈曼，因为一个叫末底改的犹太人不肯向他下拜，气得发狂。他盘算的事，比个人恩怨大得多。

ENGLISH: A decree is being copied into every language of the empire: on one day, in every province, all Jews are to be destroyed.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一道诏书正被译成帝国里的每一种文字：某一天，各省的犹太人全部处死。

ENGLISH: At the king’s gate sits Mordecai, in sackcloth and ashes, weeping loudly.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 王门口，末底改披着麻布、撒着灰，放声痛哭。

ENGLISH: Read a copy of the decree in the gate yourself
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 亲自去门口读一遍诏书的抄本

ENGLISH: The date is set eleven months out. The whole thing is legal, sealed, and public. That is what makes it so frightening.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 日子定在十一个月之后。盖了印，走了程序，还公开宣读。这才是最让人害怕的地方。

ENGLISH: Sit with Mordecai in the ashes
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 到末底改旁边，陪他坐在灰里

ENGLISH: He does not stop crying, but he makes room for you. Grief is easier to carry when someone sits down in it with you.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他没停住哭，但给你挪出了一点位置。有人肯陪你坐在悲伤里，悲伤就轻一点。

ENGLISH: Ask Corin where God is in all of this
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问柯林：这件事里，神在哪里？

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: “That is the question this entire book asks,” Corin says. “His name is never mentioned once. Watch the timing instead of looking for thunder.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「这卷书整本都在问这个问题，」柯林说，「祂的名字一次也没出现。留意那些时机。」

ENGLISH: The news reaches the palace. Esther’s maids and chamberlains tell her that Mordecai is at the gate in sackcloth, and the queen is exceedingly grieved.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 消息传进宫里。宫女和太监把末底改在门口披麻蒙灰的事告诉王后，以斯帖非常难过。

SPEAKER: hatach
ENGLISH: She has sent me to ask him what is the matter. But he will not take the clothes she offers him.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「她打发我来问是怎么回事。可他不肯收下她送去的衣服。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: There is a detail people miss: Esther is queen, but she is not free. She has not seen the king in thirty days. She was not summoned.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 有个细节常被略过：以斯帖是王后，却没有自由。她已经三十天没见到王，也没有被召见。

ENGLISH: Hathach returns from the gate with a copy of the decree and a message for the queen.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 哈他革从门口回来，带着一份诏书抄本和给王后的口信。

ENGLISH: Carry the message to Esther exactly as Mordecai gave it
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 把末底改的话一字不改地带给以斯帖

ENGLISH: You do not soften it. She reads it once, then again, very slowly. Her face does not change; her hands do.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你一个字也没改。她读了一遍，又慢慢读了一遍。脸上没什么变化，手在抖。

ENGLISH: Soften the hardest parts before you tell her
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 转述之前，先把最刺耳的地方说软

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: She thanks you — and then asks for the actual parchment. Corin gives you a look. People in danger deserve the truth, not comfort.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 她谢了你——然后要来了那份真正的羊皮卷。柯林看了你一眼。身处险境的人，配得听见实话。

ENGLISH: Ask about the law for approaching the king unsummoned
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 打听未经召见就进见的规矩

SPEAKER: hatach
ENGLISH: Hathach goes pale. “One law: whoever comes in uncalled is put to death, unless the king holds out the golden sceptre. Thirty days,” he whispers. “She has not been called in thirty days.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 哈他革脸色发白：「只有一条规矩：没有召见就进去的，一律处死，除非王向他伸出金杖。」

SPEAKER: esther
ENGLISH: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day … and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「你去招聚书珊城所有的犹大人，为我禁食三昼三夜，不吃不喝；我和我的宫女也要这样禁食。然后我违例进去见王。我若死就死吧！」

ENGLISH: But before she says it, Mordecai sends her a message that cuts through the palace walls.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 但她说这句话之前，末底改先送来一句话，穿过了宫墙。

SPEAKER: mordecai
ENGLISH: Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king’s house, more than all the Jews. For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place … and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「你莫想在王宫里强过一切犹大人，得免这祸。此时你若闭口不言，犹大人必从别处得解脱，蒙拯救……焉知你得了王后的位分，不是为现今的机会吗？」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: He does not say “God will use you.” He says “who knows?” — and then asks the question that has been echoing down every chapter of our road.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他没有说「神一定会用你」。他说的是「焉知」——然后把那个一路响到今天的问题摆在她面前。

ENGLISH: Deliver his words to Esther without changing a syllable
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 把话一字不改地送给以斯帖

SPEAKER: esther
ENGLISH: She receives the message standing. Then she sits down. Then she stands again. “Gather the people,” she says.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 她站着听完口信，坐下，又站起来。「招聚百姓。」她说。

ENGLISH: Ask Corin what “such a time as this” actually means
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问柯林：「为现今的机会」是什么意思

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: “It means your ordinary life has quietly become somebody else’s only option,” he says. “Mordecai is not flattering her. He is telling her the truth about the moment.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「意思是，你这平凡的一生，不知不觉已经成了某个人仅有的机会，」他说，「末底改不是在夸她，是把一件很重的东西交到她手里。」

ENGLISH: Remind her that deliverance will come either way
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 提醒她：就算她不开口，拯救也会来

SPEAKER: esther
ENGLISH: “God does not need me,” she says slowly — and you can see the moment the sentence frees her. “But perhaps He wants me.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「神并不需要我，」她慢慢地说，「可也许祂愿意用我。」说这话的时候，你看得出来她松了一口气。

ENGLISH: The decree goes out from the queen’s rooms: all the Jews in Susa are to fast for three days, night and day. She and her maids will fast too.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 王后的宫里传出话来：书珊城所有犹大人要禁食三昼三夜，她和宫女也一同禁食。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Fasting is not a technique for making God do something. It is making room — clearing out the noise so you can hear the one thing that matters.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 禁食不是用来支使神的技术。禁食是把心里的地方腾出来——清掉杂音，好让自己听见那件真正要紧的事。

ENGLISH: Three days. No food. No water. A whole community holding its breath together.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 三天。没有饼，没有水。一整座城一起屏住呼吸。

ENGLISH: Join the fast for all three days
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 加入这三天的禁食

ENGLISH: By the third day your head is light and your thoughts are unnervingly clear. You are not less afraid. You are less scattered.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 到第三天，头有点发轻，脑子却异常清楚。你还是怕——只是不让害怕替你做决定。

ENGLISH: Organise the fasting groups across the city
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 在城里组织一起禁食的小组

ENGLISH: You move between courtyards with lists and messages. Hundreds of people are suddenly part of the same quiet decision.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你带着名单和口信在几个院子之间奔走。几百个人忽然都卷进了同一个安静的决定。

ENGLISH: Keep watch outside the palace gate
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 到宫门外守着

ENGLISH: You stand in the heat for three days, watching who goes in and out of the throne room. Mordecai is still there in the ashes.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你在酷热里站了三天，看着谁进了王宫、谁出来。末底改还在那里。

ENGLISH: On the third day the fasting ends. Esther puts on her royal apparel and stands in the inner court of the king’s house, directly in front of the throne.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 第三天，禁食结束。以斯帖穿上朝服，站在王宫的内院，正对着王的宝座。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: She is beautifully dressed and completely terrified. Both things are true at once.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 她盛装，也怕到极点。这两件事同时都是真的。

ENGLISH: The king looks up. For a moment, absolutely nothing happens.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 王抬起头来。有那么一瞬，什么也没发生。

ENGLISH: Pray for favour with the king
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 为她在王面前蒙恩祷告

ENGLISH: No thunder. No voice. Just a woman standing still in a doorway, while an empire holds its breath.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 没有雷声，也没有声音。只有一个女人站在门廊里，而一个帝国屏住了呼吸。

ENGLISH: Plan the exact words she will say if she is allowed to speak
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 替她想好一旦开口该说什么

ENGLISH: You settle on something simple. Later you will be glad — she does not use any of it.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你想好了一句很简单的话。后来你会庆幸：她一句也没用上。

ENGLISH: Simply wait in silence with her
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 安静地陪她一起等

ENGLISH: You stand a step behind her. She knows you are there. Sometimes presence is the whole gift.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你站在她身后一步。她知道你在。有时候，你只要人在，就已经够了。

SPEAKER: king
ENGLISH: What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「王后以斯帖啊，你要什么？你求什么？就是国的一半，也必赐给你。」

ENGLISH: The golden sceptre is extended. She steps forward and touches the top of it.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 金杖伸出来了。她走上前，摸了摸杖头。

ENGLISH: And then — she does not blurt out Haman’s name. She does not accuse anyone in front of the court. She invites the king and Haman to a banquet. And then, at the banquet, to a second one.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 然后——她没有当众喊出哈曼的名字，也没有在朝臣面前控告谁。她请王和哈曼赴筵席；在筵席上，又请他们再赴一次。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: An unsummoned approach. A sceptre. Two banquets. Nothing looks like a miracle yet. That is often how providence works — in ordinary decisions made at exactly the right time.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一次没有召见的进见。一根金杖。两场筵席。没有一样看起来像神迹。神的看顾常常就是这样：在恰好的时间，做一件平凡的决定。

ENGLISH: Step forward with her into the throne room
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 和她一起走进王宫

ENGLISH: You are not summoned either. But the sceptre is out, and the moment is now. You walk.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你也没有被召见。可金杖已经伸出，时机就是现在。你走了进去。

ENGLISH: Hold your breath at the pillar and watch
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 在柱子后面屏息看着

ENGLISH: You watch a queen choose patience over accusation. Boldness and hurry are not the same thing.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你看着一位王后选择了耐心，而不是控告。勇敢和急躁，从来不是同一件事。

ENGLISH: Ask Corin why she waits until the second banquet
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问柯林，她为什么等到第二场筵席

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: “Because she is not just brave — she is wise,” he says. “Courage without gentleness can win a moment and lose a kingdom. She does both.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「因为她不只是勇敢，她还有分寸，」他说，「没有温柔的勇敢，赢了一刻，输掉一个国。她两样都有了。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: The book of Esther never once says the word “God.” And yet not one thing in it is accidental — a forgotten favour, a sleepless night, a queen in the right city in the right decade.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 以斯帖记里一次也没有出现「神」这个字。可其中没有一件事是偶然——一次被遗忘的恩情，一个睡不着的夜，一位恰好在那座城、那个十年的王后。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: You may never see a burning bush or a parted sea. You may just be standing in a doorway, at a time like this.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你也许永远看不见燃烧的荆棘，也看不见分开的海。你可能只是站在一个门廊里，在那样一个时刻。

ENGLISH: The scroll closes. But the road, somehow, does not.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 书卷合上了。可那条路，不知为什么，没有合上。
